vellum_obligation: A GPU surface's idle trim must free a resource only once it has gone unused for both its idle time and a count of recent frames, counted from frame starts, so a burst of frames after a pause still finds what the previous burst used.
evidence: ctest --test-dir build -R 'GpuIdleTrimSchedule ages by frames as well as time'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim keeps what a recent frame released across a pause'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim runs once per second of frames'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim frees textures unused for two seconds and keeps the drawn one'
